# Flatpak & Portals

> A fixture page about Flatpak, portals, and sandboxing.

Flatpak runs the app in a sandbox. [Why Linux Is Different](__BASE__start/why-linux/) explains the ecosystem.

## Portals you will use

File chooser, notifications, and screen capture go through portals.
